scope: Shared field definitions only; not a word-to-label rule engine

new_fields_only.meaning: Whole product physical weight; qualitative terms keep unresolved evidence standard

existing_field_guidance.rule: Product kind in category; dimensions, performance and preferences separately; no hard-category penalty for ordinary spec mismatch
Performance/use/user in functions; composition/material in corresponding specifications; thickness is not material
Surface motif and physical shape are distinct; unresolved wording remains pending
Course level uses existing content/content text; do not add a special course-level field
Bind product/component/gift/compatible target using exact source context; no nearest-noun guessing
Purchase count, pack content, net content, accessories and promotion are separate; no invented quantity
Retain actual unresolved strength, nonbudget tolerance, subjective standard or reference. Background does not itself create a new objective

evidence_boundary: Source-grounded extraction is distinct from SKU fact verification. Attribute/option/description are candidate observable evidence, not automatic proof of real-world quality or medical efficacy. No missing standard becomes automatic pass.
special_cases: Retain ambiguous terms/units and uncertain source scope. Do not add task-ID or product-name branches.
